title: Concept: Gemfile requirement with an open lower bound
description: Gemfile declares a `>=` requirement with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every later major satisfies the requirement, so Bundler can resolve an incompatible release the project never tested.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: Every later major satisfies the requirement, so Bundler can resolve an incompatible release the project never tested.
